title: Harpoon Pop
short_description: A 3D arcade bubble-popper: Pip the harpoon diver splits bouncing bubbles down to nothing, dodges stinger drones, and chains combos across a 12-stage world tour.
description: Harpoon Pop is a 3D arcade game about splitting bouncing bubbles with a harpoon wire. Bubbles bounce at fixed heights per size and split in two when your wire hits them; clear every bubble before the clock runs out without getting touched. Chain pops for up to an x8 multiplier, hit bubbles at the top of their arc for APEX bonuses, juggle fresh splits, and graze bubbles for near-miss bullet-time. Power-ups drop from popped bubbles: double/triple wire, power wire, rapid fire, slow-mo, force field, dynamite and extra lives. Bomb bubbles set off chain reactions, glass shelves shatter, and from stage 3 stinger drones telegraph and fire back. 12 hand-built stages from Mt. Fuji to Giza, then an endless generated world tour, with an arcade CONTINUE and local best runs. Play solo, team up ONLINE with a friend on another device (Quick Match or a 4-letter room code), or share one keyboard in local 2-player co-op. Each diver has their own lives, weapon and shield, and a downed partner returns on the next stage.
controls_keyboard: Title: ← → pick 1 PLAYER / ONLINE CO-OP / LOCAL 2P · Move ← → · Fire Space / ↑ / Z · Local P2: A D + W · P pause (offline) · M sound · N music
credits: All original: hero (Pip the harpoon diver) and stinger drone modelled and animated in Three.js code, procedural backdrops, synthesized SFX and original music compositions played by an in-code Web Audio synth band. No third-party art, models, samples or music.
